<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1200 800" width="1200" height="800">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#6ec6ff"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#b7e3ff"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#eaf6ff"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="grass" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#3a8f3a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1e5e1e"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="track" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#6fbf5a"/>
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#4ea34a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#3b8a3b"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="stand" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#9aa0a6"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#5a6066"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="sun" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fff7a0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffd24d"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <filter id="blur"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2"/></filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- Sky -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="1200" height="430" fill="url(#sky)"/>
  <!-- Sun -->
  <circle cx="1020" cy="110" r="46" fill="url(#sun)"/>
  <g opacity="0.35" stroke="#ffd24d" stroke-width="2">
    <line x1="1020" y1="40" x2="1020" y2="20"/>
    <line x1="1020" y1="180" x2="1020" y2="200"/>
    <line x1="950" y1="110" x2="930" y2="110"/>
    <line x1="1090" y1="110" x2="1110" y2="110"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Parallax clouds -->
  <g id="clouds1">
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" from="-200 0" to="1200 0" dur="40s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <g fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.85">
      <ellipse cx="200" cy="90" rx="60" ry="24"/>
      <ellipse cx="250" cy="80" rx="40" ry="18"/>
      <ellipse cx="160" cy="85" rx="35" ry="16"/>
    </g>
    <g fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.7">
      <ellipse cx="600" cy="150" rx="70" ry="26"/>
      <ellipse cx="660" cy="140" rx="45" ry="20"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  <g id="clouds2">
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" from="-600 0" to="800 0" dur="28s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <g fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.6">
      <ellipse cx="900" cy="60" rx="50" ry="18"/>
      <ellipse cx="940" cy="55" rx="30" ry="14"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Grass beyond rail (far side) -->
  <rect x="0" y="430" width="1200" height="130" fill="url(#grass)"/>
  <!-- Track -->
  <rect x="0" y="560" width="1200" height="160" fill="url(#track)"/>
  <!-- Track markings (lane lines) -->
  <g stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.5">
    <line x1="0" y1="600" x2="1200" y2="600"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="640" x2="1200" y2="640"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="680" x2="1200" y2="680"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Rails -->
  <line x1="0" y1="560" x2="1200" y2="560" stroke="#c9a227" stroke-width="6"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="720" x2="1200" y2="720" stroke="#c9a227" stroke-width="6"/>
  <!-- Rail posts -->
  <g fill="#8b5a2b">
    <rect x="0" y="552" width="6" height="20"/>
    <rect x="120" y="552" width="6" height="20"/>
    <rect x="240" y="552" width="6" height="20"/>
    <rect x="360" y="552" width="6" height="20"/>
    <rect x="480" y="552" width="6" height="20"/>
    <rect x="600" y="552" width="6" height="20"/>
    <rect x="720" y="552" width="6" height="20"/>
    <rect x="840" y="552" width="6" height="20"/>
    <rect x="960" y="552" width="6" height="20"/>
    <rect x="1080" y="552" width="6" height="20"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Grass foreground beyond near rail -->
  <rect x="0" y="720" width="1200" height="80" fill="url(#grass)"/>

  <!-- Finish line area -->
  <g>
    <rect x="1070" y="560" width="12" height="160" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9"/>
    <rect x="1070" y="560" width="12" height="20" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="1070" y="600" width="12" height="20" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="1070" y="640" width="12" height="20" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="1070" y="680" width="12" height="20" fill="#000000"/>
    <!-- Finish beam camera -->
    <rect x="1055" y="490" width="40" height="30" fill="#333" rx="4"/>
    <circle cx="1075" cy="505" r="8" fill="#111"/>
    <circle cx="1075" cy="505" r="4" fill="#4af" opacity="0.8"/>
    <line x1="1075" y1="520" x2="1075" y2="560" stroke="#555" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Photo-finish flash -->
  <rect x="1060" y="540" width="40" height="200" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0">
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0.8;0" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </rect>

  <!-- Grandstand -->
  <g>
    <!-- structure -->
    <path d="M 80 560 L 100 300 L 1100 300 L 1120 560 Z" fill="url(#stand)"/>
    <!-- roof -->
    <path d="M 60 300 L 1140 300 L 1100 260 L 100 260 Z" fill="#b33a3a"/>
    <rect x="90" y="255" width="1020" height="8" fill="#8a2a2a"/>
    <!-- flags on roof -->
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-8;8;-8" dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite" additive="sum"/>
      <g>
        <line x1="150" y1="260" x2="150" y2="220" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>
        <polygon points="150,220 190,230 150,240" fill="#e63946"/>
      </g>
      <g>
        <line x1="400" y1="260" x2="400" y2="215" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>
        <polygon points="400,215 445,228 400,240" fill="#2a9d8f"/>
      </g>
      <g>
        <line x1="700" y1="260" x2="700" y2="218" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>
        <polygon points="700,218 742,230 700,242" fill="#f4a261"/>
      </g>
      <g>
        <line x1="950" y1="260" x2="950" y2="222" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>
        <polygon points="950,222 990,233 950,245" fill="#457b9d"/>
      </g>
    </g>
    <!-- crowd (dots) -->
    <g fill="#222">
      <!-- rows -->
      <g>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0;0 -2;0 0" dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <!-- row 1 -->
        <circle cx="120" cy="330" r="6" fill="#e76f51"/>
        <circle cx="150" cy="332" r="6" fill="#264653"/>
        <circle cx="180" cy="328" r="6" fill="#f4a261"/>
        <circle cx="210" cy="331" r="6" fill="#2a9d8f"/>
        <circle cx="240" cy="329" r="6" fill="#e9c46a"/>
        <circle cx="270" cy="332" r="6" fill="#e76f51"/>
        <circle cx="300" cy="328" r="6" fill="#264653"/>
        <circle cx="330" cy="331" r="6" fill="#f4a261"/>
        <circle cx="360" cy="329" r="6" fill="#2a9d8f"/>
        <circle cx="390" cy="332" r="6" fill="#e9c46a"/>
        <circle cx="420" cy="328" r="6" fill="#e76f51"/>
        <circle cx="450" cy="331" r="6" fill="#264653"/>
        <circle cx="480" cy="329" r="6" fill="#f4a261"/>
        <circle cx="510" cy="332" r="6" fill="#2a9d8f"/>
        <circle cx="540" cy="328" r="6" fill="#e9c46a"/>
        <circle cx="570" cy="331" r="6" fill="#e76f51"/>
        <circle cx="600" cy="329" r="6" fill="#264653"/>
        <circle cx="630" cy="332" r="6" fill="#f4a261"/>
        <circle cx="660" cy="328" r="6" fill="#2a9d8f"/>
        <circle cx="690" cy="331" r="6" fill="#e9c46a"/>
        <circle cx="720" cy="329" r="6" fill="#e76f51"/>
        <circle cx="750" cy="332" r="6" fill="#264653"/>
        <circle cx="780" cy="328" r="6" fill="#f4a261"/>
        <circle cx="810" cy="331" r="6" fill="#2a9d8f"/>
        <circle cx="840" cy="329" r="6" fill="#e9c46a"/>
        <circle cx="870" cy="332" r="6" fill="#e76f51"/>
        <circle cx="900" cy="328" r="6" fill="#264653"/>
        <circle cx="930" cy="331" r="6" fill="#f4a261"/>
        <circle cx="960" cy="329" r="6" fill="#2a9d8f"/>
        <circle cx="990" cy="332" r="6" fill="#e9c46a"/>
        <circle cx="1020" cy="328" r="6" fill="#e76f51"/>
        <circle cx="1050" cy="331" r="6" fill="#264653"/>
        <circle cx="1080" cy="329" r="6" fill="#f4a261"/>
      </g>
    </g>
    <!-- waving arms overlay -->
    <g stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.7">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-5 600 360;5 600 360;-5 600 360" dur="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <line x1="200" y1="335" x2="195" y2="320"/>
      <line x1="400" y1="335" x2="405" y2="320"/>
      <line x1="600" y1="335" x2="595" y2="318"/>
      <line x1="800" y1="335" x2="805" y2="319"/>
      <line x1="1000" y1="335" x2="995" y2="321"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Tote board -->
  <g>
    <rect x="60" y="270" width="180" height="110" fill="#111" stroke="#ffd24d" stroke-width="3" rx="6"/>
    <text x="150" y="295" text-anchor="middle" fill="#ffd24d" font-size="16" font-family="sans-serif" font-weight="bold">TOTE BOARD</text>
    <g fill="#0f0" font-family="monospace" font-size="14">
      <text x="75" y="318">1  4.20</text>
      <text x="75" y="336">2  7.50</text>
      <text x="75" y="354">3  2.80</text>
      <text x="75" y="372">4  9.10</text>
    </g>
    <!-- changing highlight -->
    <rect x="62" y="306" width="176" height="18" fill="#ffd24d" opacity="0">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0.25;0" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <animate attributeName="y" values="306;324;342;360;306" dur="4.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </rect>
  </g>

  <!-- Horse template groups. We'll define 4 horses. Each translated across track. -->

  <!-- Helper: dust puff group will be separate animated -->

  <!-- Horse 1: bay, red silks -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" from="-260 0" to="900 0" dur="7.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <g transform="translate(0,640)">
      <!-- shadow -->
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="30" rx="46" ry="8" fill="#000" opacity="0.25"/>
      <!-- body -->
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="44" ry="20" fill="#6b3f1d"/>
      <!-- shading -->
      <ellipse cx="-6" cy="-6" rx="28" ry="10" fill="#8a5326" opacity="0.7"/>
      <!-- neck -->
      <rect x="28" y="-34" width="14" height="34" rx="6" fill="#6b3f1d" transform="rotate(-20 35 -17)"/>
      <!-- head -->
      <ellipse cx="46" cy="-40" rx="16" ry="10" fill="#6b3f1d"/>
      <ellipse cx="52" cy="-42" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#111"/>
      <!-- ear -->
      <polygon points="40,-48 44,-58 48,-48" fill="#6b3f1d"/>
      <!-- mane -->
      <path d="M 30,-20 Q 24,-36 34,-50 Q 26,-34 32,-22" fill="#2b1a0e">
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-6 30 -30;6 30 -30;-6 30 -30" dur="0.5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </path>
      <!-- tail -->
      <g>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-12 -38 6;12 -38 6;-12 -38 6" dur="0.7s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <path d="M -44,4 Q -62,10 -58,26" stroke="#2b1a0e" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      </g>
      <!-- legs -->
      <g stroke="#6b3f1d" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round">
        <!-- front left -->
        <line x1="26" y1="10" x2="26" y2="30">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0 26 10;25 26 10;-15 26 10;0 26 10" dur="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </line>
        <!-- front right -->
        <line x1="18" y1="12" x2="18" y2="32">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-15 18 12;0 18 12;25 18 12;-15 18 12" dur="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="0.1s"/>
        </line>
        <!-- back left -->
        <line x1="-20" y1="10" x2="-20" y2="30">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="10 -20 10;-20 -20 10;5 -20 10;10 -20 10" dur="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="0.2s"/>
        </line>
        <!-- back right -->
        <line x1="-28" y1="12" x2="-28" y2="32">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-20 -28 12;10 -28 12;-10 -28 12;-20 -28 12" dur="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="0.3s"/>
        </line>
      </g>
      <!-- hooves -->
      <g fill="#111">
        <circle cx="26" cy="32" r="3"/>
        <circle cx="18" cy="34" r="3"/>
        <circle cx="-20" cy="32" r="3"/>
        <circle cx="-28" cy="34" r="3"/>
      </g>
      <!-- saddle -->
      <ellipse cx="-4" cy="-12" rx="16" ry="8" fill="#8b4513"/>
      <!-- number -->
      <text x="-4" y="-8" text-anchor="middle" fill="#fff" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" font-family="sans-serif">1</text>
      <!-- jockey -->
      <g>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0;0 -3;0 0" dur="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <!-- body -->
        <rect x="-10" y="-38" width="14" height="26" rx="4" fill="#e63946"/>
        <!-- arms -->
        <line x1="-8" y1="-30" x2="-22" y2="-20" stroke="#e63946" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <line x1="2" y1="-30" x2="16" y2="-22" stroke="#e63946" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <!-- legs -->
        <line x1="-6" y1="-12" x2="-10" y2="0" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="-12" x2="4" y2="0" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <!-- cap -->
        <ellipse cx="-3" cy="-42" rx="9" ry="6" fill="#e63946"/>
        <rect x="-12" y="-46" width="18" height="6" rx="2" fill="#c1121f"/>
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Dust for horse1 -->
  <g opacity="0.5">
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" from="-260 0" to="900 0" dur="7.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <g transform="translate(0,670)">
      <ellipse cx="-50" cy="0" rx="14" ry="5" fill="#c9b89a">
        <animate attributeName="rx" values="14;26;14" dur="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.6;0.1;0.6" dur="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </ellipse>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Horse 2: chestnut, blue silks -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" from="-420 0" to="760 0" dur="6.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <g transform="translate(0,600)">
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="30" rx="46" ry="8" fill="#000" opacity="0.25"/>
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="44" ry="20" fill="#a0522d"/>
      <ellipse cx="-6" cy="-6" rx="28" ry="10" fill="#c06a3d" opacity="0.7"/>
      <rect x="28" y="-34" width="14" height="34" rx="6" fill="#a0522d" transform="rotate(-20 35 -17)"/>
      <ellipse cx="46" cy="-40" rx="16" ry="10" fill="#a0522d"/>
      <ellipse cx="52" cy="-42" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#111"/>
      <polygon points="40,-48 44,-58 48,-48" fill="#a0522d"/>
      <path d="M 30,-20 Q 24,-36 34,-50 Q 26,-34 32,-22" fill="#4a2810">
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-6 30 -30;6 30 -30;-6 30 -30" dur="0.55s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </path>
      <g>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-12 -38 6;12 -38 6;-12 -38 6" dur="0.75s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <path d="M -44,4 Q -62,10 -58,26" stroke="#4a2810" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      </g>
      <g stroke="#a0522d" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round">
        <line x1="26" y1="10" x2="26" y2="30">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0 26 10;25 26 10;-15 26 10;0 26 10" dur="0.38s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </line>
        <line x1="18" y1="12" x2="18" y2="32">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-15 18 12;0 18 12;25 18 12;-15 18 12" dur="0.38s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="0.09s"/>
        </line>
        <line x1="-20" y1="10" x2="-20" y2="30">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="10 -20 10;-20 -20 10;5 -20 10;10 -20 10" dur="0.38s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="0.19s"/>
        </line>
        <line x1="-28" y1="12" x2="-28" y2="32">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-20 -28 12;10 -28 12;-10 -28 12;-20 -28 12" dur="0.38s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="0.29s"/>
        </line>
      </g>
      <g fill="#111">
        <circle cx="26" cy="32" r="3"/>
        <circle cx="18" cy="34" r="3"/>
        <circle cx="-20" cy="32" r="3"/>
        <circle cx="-28" cy="34" r="3"/>
      </g>
      <ellipse cx="-4" cy="-12" rx="16" ry="8" fill="#8b4513"/>
      <text x="-4" y="-8" text-anchor="middle" fill="#fff" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" font-family="sans-serif">2</text>
      <g>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0;0 -3;0 0" dur="0.38s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <rect x="-10" y="-38" width="14" height="26" rx="4" fill="#1d3557"/>
        <line x1="-8" y1="-30" x2="-22" y2="-20" stroke="#1d3557" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <line x1="2" y1="-30" x2="16" y2="-22" stroke="#1d3557" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <line x1="-6" y1="-12" x2="-10" y2="0" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="-12" x2="4" y2="0" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <ellipse cx="-3" cy="-42" rx="9" ry="6" fill="#1d3557"/>
        <rect x="-12" y="-46" width="18" height="6" rx="2" fill="#0d1b2a"/>
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>

  <g opacity="0.5">
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" from="-420 0" to="760 0" dur="6.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <g transform="translate(0,630)">
      <ellipse cx="-50" cy="0" rx="14" ry="5" fill="#c9b89a">
        <animate attributeName="rx" values="14;26;14" dur="0.38s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.6;0.1;0.6" dur="0.38s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </ellipse>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Horse 3: grey, green silks -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" from="-100 0" to="1060 0" dur="8.0s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <g transform="translate(0,680)">
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="30" rx="46" ry="8" fill="#000" opacity="0.25"/>
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="44" ry="20" fill="#b0b0b0"/>
      <ellipse cx="-6" cy="-6" rx="28" ry="10" fill="#d0d0d0" opacity="0.7"/>
      <rect x="28" y="-34" width="14" height="34" rx="6" fill="#b0b0b0" transform="rotate(-20 35 -17)"/>
      <ellipse cx="46" cy="-40" rx="16" ry="10" fill="#b0b0b0"/>
      <ellipse cx="52" cy="-42" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#111"/>
      <polygon points="40,-48 44,-58 48,-48" fill="#b0b0b0"/>
      <path d="M 30,-20 Q 24,-36 34,-50 Q 26,-34 32,-22" fill="#606060">
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-6 30 -30;6 30 -30;-6 30 -30" dur="0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </path>
      <g>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-12 -38 6;12 -38 6;-12 -38 6" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <path d="M -44,4 Q -62,10 -58,26" stroke="#606060" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      </g>
      <g stroke="#b0b0b0" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round">
        <line x1="26" y1="10" x2="26" y2="30">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0 26 10;25 26 10;-15 26 10;0 26 10" dur="0.42s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </line>
        <line x1="18" y1="12" x2="18" y2="32">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-15 18 12;0 18 12;25 18 12;-15 18 12" dur="0.42s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="0.1s"/>
        </line>
        <line x1="-20" y1="10" x2="-20" y2="30">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="10 -20 10;-20 -20 10;5 -20 10;10 -20 10" dur="0.42s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="0.2s"/>
        </line>
        <line x1="-28" y1="12" x2="-28" y2="32">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-20 -28 12;10 -28 12;-10 -28 12;-20 -28 12" dur="0.42s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="0.3s"/>
        </line>
      </g>
      <g fill="#111">
        <circle cx="26" cy="32" r="3"/>
        <circle cx="18" cy="34" r="3"/>
        <circle cx="-20" cy="32" r="3"/>
        <circle cx="-28" cy="34" r="3"/>
      </g>
      <ellipse cx="-4" cy="-12" rx="16" ry="8" fill="#8b4513"/>
